name: exists_homeomorph_extension
statement: Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] {s : Set E} {f : E → F} {f' : E ≃L[ℝ] F} {c : ℝ≥0} (hf : ApproximatesLinearOn f (f' : E →L[ℝ] F) s c) (hc : Subsingleton E ∨ lipschitzExtensionConstant F * c < ‖(f'.symm : F →L[ℝ] E)‖₊⁻¹) : ∃ g : E ≃ₜ F, EqOn f g s

have_tree.name: fg
have_tree.body: fun x hx => by simp_rw [g, ← uf hx, Pi.sub_apply, add_sub_cancel]
